name: TQT offline OTA P256 v1

info_transport.legacy_info: Existing INFO JSON, at most512bytes; no offline fields appended over GATT.
info_transport.snapshot: The legacy INFO and binary offline INFO must describe one stable signed snapshot. Reject a mismatching pair; bounded rereads only. Reassemble offline_* JSON fields for local and HTTP verification.

cryptography.signatures: ECDSA-SHA256; raw unsigned r||s, each32 bytes, big-endian

rules: Never change the fixed generic4.0 source or binary.
Preserve online protocol1, profile layout/capabilities and the per-unit key so4.2 can install4.3 online.
The device generates a persistent P256 private key in NVS; server enrollment verifies its binding with the existing unit-key HMAC.
The phone private key stays in Android Keystore; the phone never receives the device unit key or global enrollment signer.
Use the existing public enrollment trust anchor and refuse a mismatching server key; do not generate or replace a production signing key.
A grant authorizes exactly one device public key, phone key, source counter/digest and approved target image/name/HW/FW/MAC.
Consume the source counter durably before ANY OTA COMMIT, including online; preserve counter and last-grant receipt across reboot.
Before-COMMIT interruptions can restart with the same grant and a fresh phone signature; never resume partial data across connections.
After-COMMIT recover by authenticated INFO only, never retransmit firmware merely to verify.
Device receipt must match grant UUID, target digest and counter+1; require a valid new boot before success.
No reliable device wall clock exists: firmware enforces one-use scope/counter, not an invented UTC expiry or immediate offline revocation.
Application/server enforce package validity and account policy; late or causally stale evidence is historical/conflicted and must not overwrite newer inventory.
No physical programming or production deployment is authorized by this contract.
